# hermes_messaging_platform (Resource)

Manages one fixed Hermes messaging platform without storing credentials in Terraform/OpenTofu state. Use `env_from` to name environment variables supplied to the provider process; values are sent to Hermes only during apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Hermes should enable this platform. Hermes may require a gateway restart before the change is active.
- `platform` (String) Hermes platform ID from the fixed `/api/messaging/platforms` catalog, such as `telegram`, `homeassistant`, or `email`.
- `profile` (String) Lowercase Hermes profile that owns the platform. Use `default` explicitly when intended.

### Optional

- `env_from` (Map of String) Map of Hermes environment-variable keys to provider-process variable names. For example, `HASS_TOKEN = "HERMES_HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN"`. Raw values are never stored in state.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean)
- `configured_keys` (List of String) Messaging environment-variable keys reported as set by Hermes; values are not returned.
- `error_code` (String)
- `gateway_running` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
